sections.heading: SACS MAVMM Engineering College vs Thiagarajar College of Engineering for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose SACS MAVMM Engineering College if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹3 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹40,000, in a private B.Tech setting at Madurai.
Choose Thiagarajar College of Engineering if you want a recorded NIRF 2022 #85, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, in a public B.Tech setting at Madurai.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹40,000 as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Engineering Computer Science & Engineering at SACS MAVMM Engineering College. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹98,650 as a tuition figure for B.Tech Information Technology at Thiagarajar College of Engineering. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: SACS MAVMM Engineering College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹3 LPA and a highest package of ₹8 LPA on Bachelor of Engineering Computer Science & Engineering. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Thiagarajar College of Engineering's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹24 LPA on B.Tech Information Technology. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: SACS MAVMM Engineering College is listed on our records with TNEA as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

Thiagarajar College of Engineering is listed on our records with TNEA as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Tamil Nadu. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.

SACS MAVMM Engineering College is listed as a private institute and Thiagarajar College of Engineering as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether SACS MAVMM Engineering College's recorded ₹40,000 or Thiagarajar College of Engineering's ₹98,650 fits your budget for this B.Tech.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, SACS MAVMM Engineering College or Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for SACS MAVMM Engineering College vs Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹40,000 for SACS MAVMM Engineering College on Bachelor of Engineering Computer Science & Engineering; our records list ₹98,650 for Thiagarajar College of Engineering on B.Tech Information Technology. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for SACS MAVMM Engineering College and Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: SACS MAVMM Engineering College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹3 LPA and a highest package of ₹8 LPA on Bachelor of Engineering Computer Science & Engineering. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do SACS MAVMM Engineering College and Thiagarajar College of Engineering accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list TNEA for SACS MAVMM Engineering College, and TNEA for Thiagarajar College of Engineering. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are SACS MAVMM Engineering College and Thiagarajar College of Engineering in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
